segments.text: Another git repository, and this time the master branch README says no passwords in production.
I log in as bandit29 with ssh bandit29@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
The lab blocks the localhost ssh hop, so I clone from this client.
Git pulls sixteen objects and checks out the working tree.
I open the README on master: no passwords in production, a dead end if you only look at the checked-out branch.
Listing all branches shows a remote dev branch, and a sploits dash dev branch, neither merged into master.
I ask git to show the README directly from the dev branch.
It contains the real password, for bandit thirty, and the level is solved.
